note: Folder ids are unique within a document (SPEC 3.2). A second folder with an id already used is dropped and reported with `folder-duplicate-id` at its `id`; the first one stays, so the point that names `lakes` sits in the first folder and raises nothing. A folder with no `id` is missing a REQUIRED key, so it is dropped with `wrong-type-required` at the folder (SPEC 3.10, 6.2). `counts` pins that exactly one folder survives: a reader that keeps both duplicates, or drops both, fails.
